description: Events eligible for contribution association for the current user

goalPercent.description: Percentage of the event goal completed. Absent if the event has no goal.

goalDescription.description: Localised sentence describing the event goal. Absent if the event has no goal.

goalNumericText.description: Localised progress towards the event goal, as current and target values. Absent if the event has no goal.

autoAssociable.description: Whether this event's contribution association can be performed automatically without showing the dialog.
